# registry_policy_evaluation (Data Source)

Evaluates input against the rego policy bundle at plan time. Useful for policy-gating resource creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_policy_evaluation" "mirror_upstream" {
  query = "data.authz.allow"
  input_json = jsonencode({
    action   = "mirror"
    upstream = "registry.terraform.io"
  })
}

output "mirror_allowed" {
  value = data.registry_policy_evaluation.mirror_upstream.allowed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input_json` (String) JSON-encoded input document to evaluate against the policy bundle.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Optional rego query path (e.g. 'data.authz.allow'). Defaults to the bundle entry point if omitted.

### Read-Only

- `allowed` (Boolean) Whether the policy evaluation returned an allow decision.
- `reason` (String) Human-readable reason returned by the policy (if provided).
- `result_json` (String) Full policy result serialised as JSON.
